Definition: Nahalal or Nahalol, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Nahalal is a town of Zebulun, named in the division of the land and again in the failure to drive out the Canaanites. In Joshua 19:15 Nahallal stands among the cities of Zebulun with Kattath and Shimron and Idalah, and in Judges 1:30 Zebulun did not drive out the inhabitants of Kitron nor the inhabitants of Nahalol, but the Canaanites dwelt among them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a town given and not taken is the story of Zebulun in one verse. Nahalal was theirs on paper and shared in fact, because they would not finish the work.
